title: Law of the Fourier coefficient estimator
statement: Let $n,m\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a target function, and let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The estimator's outcome law is obtained by drawing $m$ independent uniform inputs $x_1,\ldots,x_m\in\{\pm1\}^n$, returning the empirical coefficient $\frac1m\sum_{j=1}^m f(x_j)\prod_{i\in S}(x_j)_i$, and recording learning cost $(m,0,m+m(|S|+1))$.
hypotheses_covered: target Boolean function on the n-dimensional sign cube
